subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is relieved that someone else took an expense off his account.
source_quote: Well, that saves me money on potions," said Grygum, relieved — someone else had just taken an expense off his account.

subject: Queenie
fact: Queenie is a five-year-old sleet-grey cat who is entirely uninterested in being disturbed.
source_quote: Queenie — five years old, sleet-grey, and entirely uninterested in being disturbed.

subject: Queenie
fact: Queenie announces that she did not order any more ticklers.
source_quote: I did not order any more ticklers!

subject: Queenie
fact: Queenie says good ticklers are the only good reason for disturbing her beauty sleep.
source_quote: Any good ticklers are the only good… and good ticklers are… tickles are only the good reason for disturbing my beauty sleep.

subject: tickling Queenie
fact: The narrator tickles Queenie to gain information.
source_quote: I'll give Queenie a little tickle," I said, and tickled.

subject: Sylvira Savikas
fact: Sylvira Savikas woke Queenie from a nap by blasting the armchamber with a lance of unerring force light.
source_quote: only to be rudely awakened some thirty minutes later by our Sylvira Savikas, this is in the morning, blasting the armchamber with a lance of unerring force light.

subject: Janussi
fact: Janussi is in an on-and-off-again relationship with Sylvira Savikas.
source_quote: Sylvira the tiefling, and Janussi, an on-and-off-again relationship.

subject: Fheminor
fact: Fheminor is referred to by Queenie as 'the short-legged one.'
source_quote: first Fheminor, *the short-legged one*

subject: Daral
fact: Daral is referred to by Queenie as 'the stinky breath one.'
source_quote: later Daral, *the stinky breath one*

subject: Daral running downstairs with a hypnotic block
fact: Daral ran downstairs with a hypnotic block after shouting.
source_quote: when I later saw him run downstairs with a hypnotic block.

subject: hypnotic block
fact: The hypnotic block is a book that holds a person motionless and uninterested in scratching a cat.
source_quote: A book. Not a device, not an enchantment — a book, dull enough to hold a person motionless and uninterested in scratching a cat.

subject: The Golden Ass
fact: The Golden Ass is the missing book that Daral carried out of the room.
source_quote: *The Golden Ass*, the missing volume, walking out of the room under Daral's arm.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir incorrectly identifies the hypnotic block as a TV.
source_quote: Oh, it's a TV!" said Zalthir

subject: Daral leaving with The Golden Ass
fact: Daral exited with The Golden Ass while the victim was still alive.
source_quote: But the victim was still alive when Daral left," Thorin noted, and the timeline held.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Queenie saw a figure resembling Sylvira coming down the steps but not smelling like her.
source_quote: I saw *the torn demon lady* coming down the steps — Sylvira's shape — 'But she didn't smell like the demon lady, though.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin identifies the situation as a shapeshifter.
source_quote: Oh, so we've got, like, a shapeshifter situation going on here," said Thorin.

subject: candle
fact: Zalthir mentions the candle in connection with the shapeshifter theory.
source_quote: That explains the candle," said Zalthir

subject: Queenie
fact: Queenie refuses to provide more details about blood, organs, or a heart from the wrong-smelling figure.
source_quote: Queenie was done being generous. 'There have been too little Tickles and too many questions.'

subject: tickling Queenie again
fact: The narrator tickles Queenie again to elicit more information.
source_quote: I tickled. I tickled some more.

subject: Queenie
fact: Queenie insults two-leggers by saying they hardly ever lick themselves.
source_quote: It's clear that you hardly ever lick yourselves at all. I've met cleaner dogs in my time.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum suggests asking Queenie about the locket missing from Janussi's neck.
source_quote: Daz, why don't you ask the cat anyway? It's gonna be a weird description from a cat, but…

subject: locket
fact: The locket was carried by Janussi at all times and never taken off.
source_quote: The locket itself is intimate. He carried it all the time. He never took it off.

subject: Fembris
fact: Fembris reveals that Janussi held one of the two keys to the Hightower Library.
source_quote: Fembris, *by golly*, supplied the column I was missing: Janussi held one of the two keys to the Hightower Library.

subject: Kalan
fact: Kalan is the gate warden who holds the other key to the Hightower Library.
source_quote: The other key, I learned, rested with Kalan, the gate warden.

subject: adding keys to the account
fact: The narrator adds both keys to the account after learning their locations.
source_quote: I added both to the account.

subject: offering more tickles
fact: The narrator offers more tickles to settle the account with Queenie.
source_quote: More tickles, more padding," I offered, because the account wasn't quite settled.

subject: Queenie
fact: Queenie tells the narrator to leave and to give themselves a proper licking before returning.
source_quote: You may now leave," she said, "and please give yourself a proper licking before returning to my tower.

subject: armchamber
fact: The armchamber is the location where Sylvira Savikas blasted a lance of force light.
source_quote: blasting the armchamber with a lance of unerring force light.

subject: corridor
fact: Queenie retreated to the corridor after Daral's shouting.
source_quote: she retreated to the corridor

subject: tower
fact: Queenie resides in a tower that the narrator is expected to return to.
source_quote: before returning to my tower.

subject: The Golden Ass
fact: The Golden Ass is linked to the deletion of information from a book that no one should have touched.
source_quote: That might explain why that stuff got deleted off that book that no one should have touched.

subject: shapeshifter
fact: The shapeshifter theory is connected to the absence of Sylvira's scent and the presence of the candle.
source_quote: That explains the candle," said Zalthir, and the picture began to assemble itself.
